facts.text: Under the Finish in 4 program, Dominican University New York covers the cost of any remaining courses needed to graduate if a student cannot finish in four years.

sources.title: College Unveils New Finish in 4 Program - Dominican University
sources.quote: If a student follows the requirements of the program, but is not able to graduate in four years, the College will cover the cost of any remaining courses needed to complete a degree.
